eu-oversize-weekly-2026-w46.approvedText:
Planning a heavy or abnormal load through western Germany this month? The A4 towards Olpe is set to close between Engelskirchen and Bielstein from 9 November, while a barrier for trucks over 44 tonnes is installed at the Wiehltal bridge.

For dispatchers and carriers, that means checking routes early and not relying on the usual A4 corridor. Oversize drivers should also review alternatives before departure rather than on the road.

The EU Oversize Weekly for 9–15 November 2026 also covers a schedule change affecting truck drivers: ECT has postponed its driver safety test to 5 January 2027. In addition, Italian abnormal-load permits are reported at about 90 days, which is relevant for lead-time planning.
